name: Entity world
body: `VectorMath`'s slerp and matrix decomposition follow glam's scalar and NEON code, which is what an Apple arm64 build of the Rust engine runs. `transforms-slerp-and-decompose-as-glam-scalar-math-does` compares 15 slerps and 3 decompositions with glam 0.30.10 built with `features = ["scalar-math"]`, bit for bit. glam's default x86-64 build uses SSE2, whose `Quat::slerp` has its own `sin` approximation and divides by `theta_sin`, so it differs by an ulp or two. Only interpolated rendering uses slerp, not the physics traces.
